name: Katagiri Tsubame
source: Kouhei sees her as a very responsible senior student. Tsubame is a student with excellent grades, and a beauty who used to be the student council president. [spoiler]She's highly willing to take care of Kouhei because she's secretly in love with him.[/spoiler]
